clue.text: What is wrong in the record being beaten?

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the record's word here

parts.note: a log is a record, as in a ship's log
a sin is something morally wrong

explanation.surface: A question about what went wrong when a record was broken.
explanation.definitionFit: Losing describes a side currently being defeated in a contest.

clue.text: Kill dead, accepting one pound for it

indicators.note: accepting means the word for dead takes the other letters into itself

parts.note: the late person is a dead one
I is the Roman numeral for one
quid is British slang for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A hitman finishes off a victim, taking a pound as payment.
explanation.definitionFit: To liquidate someone is a euphemism for killing or eliminating them.

clue.text: Woman will get bill for coat

parts.note: she is a pronoun for a woman
'll is the contracted form of will
AC, short for account, is a bill

explanation.surface: A woman is going to be invoiced for a coat she bought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coat' looks like a garment but is a verb: to cover with varnish.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellac is a resin varnish, and to shellac something is to coat it with that varnish.

clue.text: One wants to be so described

definitions.text: One wants to be so described

parts.words: One wants to be so described
parts.note: read literally, a person who is in want, that is poor, fits this description

explanation.definitionFit: A needy person is one who wants, in the old sense of lacking necessities.

clue.text: Unusually arrogant cooks may use it

indicators.note: unusually suggests the letters of the next word appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Proud chefs behaving in an odd way in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarragon is a culinary herb used by cooks, especially in French dishes.

clue.text: Fruit for the London flight

definitions.meaning: Cockney rhyming slang for stairs, a flight of steps in London speech

explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang replaces a word with a phrase that rhymes with it: this pair of fruits rhymes with stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit pair is literal, and in Cockney rhyming slang the phrase means stairs, a flight.

clue.text: Part of standard for Japanese students?

definitions.text: Part of standard for Japanese students?

parts.words: Part of standard for Japanese students?
parts.note: the emblem on Japan's flag, and a whimsical picture of students getting up in the morning

explanation.definitionFit: Japan's flag, its standard, shows a red disc representing the sun coming up over the horizon.

clue.text: Painting and suffering, having quit university earlier

indicators.note: earlier places the quitting and university pieces before the suffering

parts.note: to quit is to go, to leave
an ache is a form of suffering

explanation.surface: An artist's pain after dropping out of college.
explanation.definitionFit: Gouache is a type of opaque watercolour painting.

clue.text: Crunchy crackers

definitions.meaning: full of nuts, so with a crunchy texture

explanation.definitionFit: Nutty can mean containing nuts, hence crunchy, or slangily mad.

clue.text: Take action hastily and overcharge personal receivers

parts.note: to rush someone is slang for charging them too much
one's means belonging to a person, personal
fences are receivers of stolen goods

explanation.surface: A dodgy dealer overcharges people who handle stolen goods.
explanation.walkthrough: To rush one's fences is a hunting idiom for jumping too hastily.
explanation.definitionFit: The hunting idiom describes a rider charging at jumps, so acting too precipitately.

clue.text: Refuse to step into line

parts.note: declining to join the end of a waiting line, pushing in ahead instead

explanation.definitionFit: To push in ahead of others waiting is to avoid taking one's place in the line.

clue.text: Settle without recourse to law

parts.note: occupying property without any legal right to it

explanation.definitionFit: Squatters settle in empty buildings or land without legal title.

clue.text: Marquetry that's fashionable but having an unprofessional finish

parts.note: in means in fashion
lay means not belonging to a profession, amateur

explanation.surface: Trendy woodwork let down by amateurish finishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Inlay is decoration set into a surface, the technique behind marquetry.

clue.text: Loud clamour may lead to apprehension

definitions.text: Loud clamour may lead to apprehension

parts.words: Loud clamour may lead to apprehension
parts.note: the old public outcry raised to pursue a criminal, which led to arrest

explanation.definitionFit: Historically this outcry summoned people to chase a felon, so it led to an arrest.

clue.text: Notes made by a novice driver involved in pile-ups

indicators.note: involved in places the learner pieces inside the pile-ups word

parts.note: pile-ups are road accidents
L is the learner plate a novice driver displays in Britain

explanation.surface: A learner driver is caught up in a series of crashes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Notes' is musical: accidentals are sharps, flats and naturals.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, accidentals are notes raised or lowered from the key signature.

clue.text: Is it never found in the light cavalry?

definitions.text: Is it never found in the light cavalry?

parts.words: Is it never found in the light cavalry?
parts.note: a horse of a dark colour would seem out of place among light cavalry

explanation.definitionFit: A little-known contender who unexpectedly succeeds, figuratively an unlit horse.

clue.text: Go out after a rise

parts.note: the tide recedes after it has come in

explanation.definitionFit: The tide's outflow follows its high point, its rise.

clue.text: Expect high tolls here

parts.note: tolls read as the ringing of bells high up, not charges

explanation.definitionFit: A tall structure housing bells, where they are tolled high above the ground.

clue.text: Part of week-end, also long ago

indicators.note: part of signals letters taken from inside the compound word

explanation.surface: Something to do with a weekend long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long ago' marks the definition as archaic: eke meant also.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning also or moreover.

clue.text: Fractions of the highest order

indicators.note: order hints at putting the letters of highest into a new order

explanation.surface: Portions of the very top rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Eighths are fractions, each one part of eight.

clue.text: Revised rent is ideal for dwelling

indicators.note: revised signals that the letters are reworked into another arrangement

explanation.surface: A landlord's changed rental price is perfect for a home.
explanation.definitionFit: Residential describes property meant for people to live in.

clue.text: Fail to draw positive conclusions from The work dante's work

annotationWithheld.clue: Fail to draw positive conclusions from The work dante's work

clue.text: Mature cheddar for the boss

parts.note: big means grown-up, mature
cheddar is a cheese

explanation.surface: A strong cheddar presented to the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for an important person in charge.

clue.text: Money raised by word of mouth

indicators.note: by word of mouth tells us to go by how a word is spoken

parts.note: bred means raised, as children or animals

explanation.surface: Funds collected by talking people round.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread is slang for money.

clue.text: Become the object of the exercise

definitions.meaning: the goal of physical exercise, to be in good shape

explanation.definitionFit: To befit is to suit; read as two words it means to be in good shape.

clue.text: Vessel in dock

definitions.meaning: an enclosed area of water for ships

explanation.definitionFit: A basin is a bowl and also an enclosed harbour area.

clue.text: Record a stage direction

definitions.meaning: the instruction telling an actor to come on stage

explanation.definitionFit: To enter is to record in a book, and in scripts it directs an actor on.

clue.text: Irish county's team opener

parts.note: Cork is a county in Ireland, plus 's
a crew is a team

explanation.surface: An Irish county side's first player.
explanation.definitionFit: A corkscrew is a tool for opening bottles.

clue.text: Excuse to give to others

definitions.meaning: exempt, as in ... with or from

explanation.definitionFit: To dispense is to hand out, and a dispensation excuses someone from a rule.

clue.text: Competitors need to enter for these games

definitions.text: Competitors need to enter for these games

parts.words: Competitors need to enter for these games
parts.note: players must come in under a roof, through an entrance, to play such sports

explanation.definitionFit: Games played inside a building rather than outdoors.
